g.text: vcf-diode-ladder: NPN pair pair -> 2 x 4 x diode ladder with 4 x 2.2 nF C0G, top at +6 V; followers + x84 diff amp

g.desc: vcf-diode-ladder: NPN pair pair -> 2 x 4 x diode ladder with 4 x 2.2 nF C0G, top at +6 V; followers + x84 diff amp

g.text: Cutoff: expo converter (servo 12 uA), ~490 Hz per uA of tail current; knob centre ~1 kHz, +/-5 oct; CV1 1V/oct.

g.desc: Cutoff: expo converter (servo 12 uA), ~490 Hz per uA of tail current; knob centre ~1 kHz, +/-5 oct; CV1 1V/oct.

g.text: Resonance: OUT -> VCA (OTA OTA + op-amp, gain = Iabc / 0.53 mA) -> 10 uF -> 2.2k into the second base; self-oscillates at full.

g.desc: Resonance: OUT -> VCA (OTA OTA + op-amp, gain = Iabc / 0.53 mA) -> 10 uF -> 2.2k into the second base; self-oscillates at full.

g.text: Iabc: RESONANCE pot (33k, 0.28 mA at full = gain 0.53; oscillates from ~72 % of the knob) + RES CV jack and CV_RES (18k each) -> U4B + Q4; RV2 nulls the OTA's offset. Input 100k/1k (+/-50 mV at +/-5 V).

g.desc: Iabc: RESONANCE pot (33k, 0.28 mA at full = gain 0.53; oscillates from ~72 % of the knob) + RES CV jack and CV_RES (18k each) -> U4B + Q4; RV2 nulls the OTA's offset. Input 100k/1k (+/-50 mV at +/-5 V).
